evidence.quote: Price stability is a primary responsibility of the Federal Reserve. This is why we have taken forceful steps aimed at reducing inflation—and why we will stay on the job to achieve our objective.
in tightening monetary policy since early last year, we've made clear that we're determined to bring inflation down to 2 percent.
These findings include the "Taylor principle" notion that deviations of inflation from target should likely be met by a more than one-for-one response of the federal funds rate
it used forward guidance to make clear our intention to reach a policy stance that is sufficiently restrictive to bring inflation back to 2 percent.

parsed.rationale: The speech is largely a retrospective on policy rules, but it closes with a commitment to stay on the job against inflation and endorses the Taylor principle, a mild hawkish lean. It offers no current data assessment, and its caution about responding to labor-market gap estimates is methodological.
